RCA — REAL BUG (not not-a-bug), fix ESCALATED. Investigated live drift (read-only reconcile-check + runtime probes of the production code paths). ## What reconcile-check reported total_bindings=2700, checked=1151, in_sync=68, discrepancies=1091 (description=1080, status=6, assignee=5), orphaned_bindings=1549, unbound_local=2709. Report: bridge_state/reconcile-check.json. ## Findings 1. DESCRIPTION (1080) — mix of diagnostic over-report + a REAL reconciler defect. - Mechanism: outbound AdfCodec.normalize_outbound(fit_outbound(x)) inserts a BLANK LINE between ADF blocks ('## Context\n\nBody'); the differ's InboundMapper decodes remote/baseline via adapters/jira/adf.py::adf_to_text which uses a SINGLE '\n' ('## Context\nBody'). adf_to_text is NOT the inverse of normalize_outbound, so decode(encode(x)) != x and outbound_field_diff.diff_canonical_fields re-emits changed['description'] every pass for any multi-block, blank-line-stored body. Confirmed at runtime: codec's own decode_inbound satisfies decode(encode(x))==x = True, but the differ path (adf_to_text) = False; a 2-pass diff_canonical_fields sim churns a blank-line body forever, a single-\n body does not. - reconcile-check itself over-reports: _compare_pair compares fitted vs adf_to_text raw with NO baseline guard, so it flags EVERY multi-block description. Applying the symmetric outbound-port compare collapses 1080 -> 3 genuine diffs. - Severity: 2603/5412 local tickets are blank-line-stored (churn-eligible). Corroborated by tabled epic e594-e1d0 ('scattered delta every pass ~987 versions ~= ~987 passes'). This VIOLATES the description-convergence contract established by 3388-96e8 (needs the codec law decode(encode(x))==x). - The 3 genuine description diffs are ordinary drift, not codec bugs: '- [x]' vs '- [ ]' acceptance-checkbox state (local ahead of Jira) on REB-3523/REB-3139 and an empty '

' on REB-1374. 2. STATUS (6) + ASSIGNEE (5) — benign local-ahead-of-Jira pending outbound syncs (e.g. REB-3556 local closed/assigned vs Jira 'To Do'/unassigned). Not defects; a live sync pushes them. 3. orphaned_bindings (1549) + unbound_local (2709) — expected: rebar-native tickets never mirrored to Jira, and bindings to ids outside the loaded snapshot. No data loss (consistent with sibling jira-reb-3510's blank-description not-a-bug finding). ## caused_by Description-convergence design that assumes decode(encode(x))==x (3388-96e8; codec split J3 aac8-b283) while the differ canonicalizes the remote/baseline via adf_to_text (a32a-4549 / 17c3 / e339 use the same normalize_rich_text->adf_to_text on the comment side). Same churn class as tabled epic e594-e1d0. ## Why ESCALATE (not auto-fixed) The fix changes core reconciler CONVERGENCE semantics and what the reconciler writes to Jira; two viable designs (A: differ canonicalizes description via the codec's decode_inbound; B: symmetric outbound-port compare in diff_canonical_fields + reconcile_check). Blast radius touches local storage + comment decode (adf_to_text is shared). Epic e594-e1d0 explicitly TABLED sensitive reconciler-core churn 'by decision', so a human/ADR call is required. Fix tracked as discovered_from bug nomadic-relieved-shorebird (7f5a-c602). No Jira mutations performed (read-only).
